test_item:
Key Installation Status Query Interface
(installation completed; the interface returns INSTALLED (2))
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Key installation has completed successfully on the DUT
3. Diagnostic session is SystemSupplierSpecific (60)
input: USB drive containing valid platform keys of group X-f, already installed
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys
2. Query the installation status through the Binder interface
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.keyinstall.test.KeyInstallStatusTest#getStatus com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.keyinstall.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
3. Send UDS request ReadDataByIdentifier for DID $FF02 (SecurityKeyInstallStatus)
$ 22 FF 02
er:
1. `$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys` shows the installstate value 2
2. The instrumentation runner reports `OK (1 test)` and getStatus() returns `INSTALLED (2)`
3. Positive response is received: 62 FF 02 00
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-011 Verification Criteria 1.1/2.1/3.1 (Binder getStatus verbatim); R1L Diag SWQT 22345/22346 for DID FF02
RD ID spelling as delivered. DID 22 FF 02 is supplementary observation only, not a pass/fail criterion (R-SEC8(e))
